card.name: Space before a number after every/per
card.fires_on: A space or short word right before a number in a rate or interval, mostly after "every" (every 3 weeks) or "per" (per 1000). Also a few spots inside a number or after a stored-and-discarded time phrase.

modes.label: Interval after every
modes.description: The blank space after "every" just before a number of weeks, months or days.
modes.example: every<< >>3 months thereafter, and urgently at any

modes.label: Rate after per
modes.description: The space after "per" just before a count such as 1000.

modes.label: Other timing spots
modes.description: A word or digit in a time span, such as discarded before a number of days, or the 1 of 12-month.

card.writes: Suppresses "half" and similar words, so it steers away from fractions and toward a plain number after the interval.
card.plain: It marks the point right before a number in phrases like "every 3 weeks" or "per 1000".
